scope: Entire unchanged command-execution recipe and all 17 children. GNU and rboxc outputs agree within native/instrumented modes after only work-directory substitution for comparison; original expected output is not altered and this is an assertion baseline, not a pass. Native trap order differs from the original platform; the Python privilege helper adds ignored PIPE/XFSZ. Valgrind adds RTMAX, rewrites argv[0], and cannot recover from the ordinary E2BIG exec failure. A 30-byte trap-restoration leak and incomplete exec-failure image remain open.
